1778-5006-8170-8227.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
1778-5006-8170-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1778-5006-8170-8227.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Loot by sacrificing Memnite, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

2131-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

728-3234-3293-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
728-3234-3293-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat
728-3234-3293-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1170-2921-5131-6289--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-5131-6289--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

475-4186-6824-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-4186-6824-7810.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control
with power 1 or greater and without summoning sickness

1843-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

413-1263-4871-6248.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

129-1409-6006-6633.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2523-2869-3944.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Blood Pet that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Blood Pet token

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3033-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3033-5256-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

147-5188-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5188-5686.description:
Cast Dread Return by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Dread Return.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dread Return
Resolve the Dread Return copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3263-7267.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-7267.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

1642-7276.manaNeeded: {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable if Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield
1642-7276.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Dark Leo & Shredder if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
Dark Leo & Shredder doesn't have summoning sickness if it's on the battlefield.
You control at least four Ninjas.
1642-7276.description:
Declare Dark Leo & Shredder as an attacker if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
If Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield, when the declared creature is unblocked, cast Dark Leo & Shredder either from your hand or from the command zone for its sneak cost by paying {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable and returning the unblocked attacker to your hand.
Deal combat damage using Dark Leo & Shredder, triggering its second ability, creating a 1/1 Ninja creature token and causing the opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing the opponent to lose the rest of their life total.
1642-7276.notes: You must control four Ninjas when Dark Leo & Shredder deals combat damage. Notably, if it isn't on the battlefield, you must control five total Ninjas if the attacker you will be returning is a Ninja.

877-4865-6967.description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Shapeshifter triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

3652-5220-5686-6900.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1621-6913.description:
Cast Chameleon by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Chameleon enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have Chameleon enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-5399.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Pirated Copy.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Pirated Copy by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1306-1456-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

475-2919-4186-4321.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-2919-4186-4321.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1306-1690-2538-4030.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Starnheim Courser.
1306-1690-2538-4030.description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Crypt to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1306-1690-2538-4030.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

803-3767-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
803-3767-3918-4002.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2997-5657-6489.manaNeeded: {4}{C}{C}{C}{G/U}{G/U} plus enough mana to cast the additional Eldrazi spell
2997-5657-6489.notablePrerequisites: You have another Eldrazi creature card in hand.
2997-5657-6489.description:
Cast any other Eldrazi except Drowner of Truth by paying its mana cost, triggering Ulalek.
Holding priority, cast Drowner of Truth by paying {4}{C}{G/U}{G/U}.
Drowner of Truth and Ulalek trigger.
Resolve the Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Drowner of Truth's trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy all spells you control and then copy all activated and triggered abilities you control, ensuring to put Drowner of Truth's trigger on top of Ulalek's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1809-4050-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
1809-4050-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Returned Pastcaller and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Returned Pastcaller, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

933-2724-3080-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

913-4222-5390-5516.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
913-4222-5390-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
913-4222-5390-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

4017-5296-6081--60.manaNeeded: {6}{W} plus enougb mana to animate the land (if needed)
4017-5296-6081--60.notablePrerequisites: The land has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-5296-6081--60.description:
If needed, animate the land, causing it to become a creature.
Cast Sunbond by paying its mana cost, attaching it to the animated land.
Activate Black Panther by paying {3}, moving all +1/+1 counters from the animated land to Workhorse, then causing you to gain at least 3 life and draw a card.
The animated land triggers, putting at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
4017-5296-6081--60.notes: If the land has four or more +1/+1 counters on it, this combo will net near-infinite +1/+1 counters on Workhorse and/or another creature of your choosing.

1238-2351-4452-5256-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

2438-2523-5559.description:
Cast Nazgûl by paying {2}{B}.
Nazgûl enters, triggering its first activated ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nazgûl.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Resolve the ability from step 4, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-3129-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three members in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-3129-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens and causing the defending player to lose 4 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
